lines.en: Who spilled the nectar?
Rusty wing edges mark me.
Don't lag — follow my wings.
I could fly this stretch blind.
The wreck's wood rotted long ago.

lines.zh: 我这锈色的翅尖，是黑森林的秋。
lines.en: My rusty wingtips are the dark forest's autumn.
Today's wind is colder than yesterday's.

lines.zh: 别拦我，我要飞进林深处。
lines.en: Don't stop me; I'm going deeper into the woods.
Where the scent drifts, I follow.
The flowers along the way are lovely.
One wingbeat and I'm off.
I'll rest once I cross this flower field.

lines.zh: 水面上的水泡，跟着我走。
lines.en: The bubbles on the water follow me.
Something stirs beneath the leaves.
This draft through the trees is a nuisance.
The light through the canopy is blinding.
A shadow passed across my wing.

lines.zh: 我的翅边是锈一样的红。
lines.en: My wing edges are rust-red.
How many flowers have I counted?
By the flower field, only water sounds.

lines.zh: 就这样停在花上也不坏。
lines.en: Resting on this flower isn't bad.
My wing edge looks like rusted paper.
A little tired, so I rest on a leaf's back.
That flower sways so slowly.
Nectar… real nectar.

lines.zh: 我在等鱼群从黑森林边过。
lines.en: Waiting for the school by the dark forest.
My reflection watches from a dewdrop.
This petal feels so soft.

lines.zh: 我翅上的锈色在发光吗？
lines.en: Is the rust on my wings glowing?
I wonder how dense this dark forest is.
Did you come from beyond the dark forest?

lines.zh: 你不像蜜源，也不像天敌。
lines.en: You're neither flower nor leaf.

lines.zh: 你一站，花上的光就暗了。
lines.en: You stand and the flowers lose their light.

lines.zh: 锈色的翅，泡在水里也不掉色。
lines.en: Rust-colored wings that don't fade underwater.
I know that smell of rust on you.

lines.zh: 你走你的路，我落我的花。
lines.en: You walk your path; I light on my flowers.
You smell of pine resin and iron.
In the flower fields, I only know flowers.
My wing edges look rusted.
You walk so slow the flowers fret.
Who strung a net in the dark forest?
A small chip is missing from my wing.
Ouch! Who pinched my wing?

lines.zh: 再按一下，我的翅就折了。
lines.en: One more touch and my wing tears.
Don't squeeze. My wing powder comes off.
This mark on my wing — I'll remember it.
That rust at my wingtips rubbed off.
I just landed and I'm not steady.
The pain spins me between flowers.
A chip is missing from my wing.
I'll land only a moment, really.
One sip, just one.
Who spilled nectar all over?

lines.zh: 那点亮，比我翅膀更晃眼。
lines.en: That glint is brighter than my wings.
Sweet nectar, but I dare not land.
Sweeter than tree sap.
Don't close your hand; let me look.

lines.zh: 那味道在我触角上打转。
lines.en: That scent circles my antennae.
Smells like rotting fruit!
Leave me one sip of nectar.

lines.zh: 你擦掉我翅尖一点锈色。
lines.en: You brushed the tip of my wing.
Three wingbeats and I steady myself.
Hey, you nearly folded my wing!
You knocked my wing veins askew.
Go around me next time — these wings are thin.
The rust colour on my wing edge is not dirt.
In black forests I pick which flower to rest on.
Passing through. Don't block the current.

lines.zh: 黑森林太暗，我贴着花飞。
lines.en: The dark forest is dim; I hug the flowers.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，花粉都震落了。
lines.en: Your bump shook the pollen off me.
Your wings hold the sunset.
This flower will witness for us.
The dark forest flowers make no sound.
Fly across these flowers with me.
I'll circle you once.

lines.zh: 花海的影子底下，我们并排飞。
lines.en: Under flower shadows, we fly side by side.

lines.zh: 我在叶背上留了个位置。
lines.en: I saved a spot on the leaf's underside.

lines.zh: 你愿意停在同朵花上吗？
lines.en: Will you rest on the same flower?
Don't hide — no one watches in the dark forest.
Let's fly wing to wing till dawn.
I'll tuck it under the fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 这片锈色，是我名字的来处。
lines.en: This rusty color is where my name comes from.
A rust-colored scrap counts as treasure.

lines.zh: 翅尖一点锈色，是我的标记。
lines.en: A rust-colored tip marks my wing.

lines.zh: 这么重，我飞得歪歪扭扭。
lines.en: So heavy I fly crooked.
I landed on this flower first.

lines.zh: 你掉的？锈色的翅膀作证。
lines.en: You dropped it? My rust wings witness it.
It doesn't feel like a petal.

lines.zh: 黑森林的落叶里，藏着东西。
lines.en: Something hides in the dark leaf litter.
A rust-colored wing settles on a flower.
This bloom will feed me till dusk.
That flower is mine.

lines.zh: 黑森林这么窄，你跑不掉的。
lines.en: The dark forest is narrow, you cannot escape.
That red flower — stay still.
Bitten, and even rusty teeth do not let go.
On three, I fly.
The flower twitches — that's it.
You're under the leaf litter of this dark wood.
My wing edges are rust-colored like old iron.

lines.zh: 我在花海上，慢慢圈一个圆。
lines.en: Over the flower field, I circle slowly.
As long as my wings beat, I don't stop.
In the dark forest, a bloom falls per step.
However dense the trees, you can't escape.

lines.zh: 黑森林的花，开一朵我守一朵。
lines.en: Each dark-forest bloom, I guard as it opens.
The current turns, and I turn with it.
This seagrass bed is my patrol.
Your steps are slowing.
My wing edges look rusted
The dark forest flowers draw nearer.
Don't run into the light at the forest's edge!
Stay away from the leaf I roost on.

lines.zh: 退开，这是最后一次提醒。
lines.en: Back off, last warning.

lines.zh: 这一点点重量，也撞得偏。
lines.en: This little weight still knocks you off line.
You dare touch the flower I rest on?
I'll send you out where the forest is bright.
Your hand is quick; my wings are quicker.
My wing edges are harder than they look.
I can ram once more.
Get out of this flower patch.
Stop struggling under my wings.

lines.zh: 我从茧里出来，谁在等我？
lines.en: I'm out of the cocoon — who's waiting?
My wings aren't dry yet.
I know this tree's bark.
Any nets nearby? None, I hope.

lines.zh: 黑森林的湿气，沾在我翅上。
lines.en: Dark forest damp clings to my wings.
How did I end up on this flower?
The wind carried me here.
First, I'll smooth the scales on my wings.

lines.zh: 别吃我，我翅上都是鳞粉。
lines.en: Don't eat me; my wings are all dust.
My rust-tipped wings touch the water.

lines.zh: 火把我翅膀的边缘烤焦。
lines.en: Fire scorched the edge of my wing.

lines.zh: 落进花海的浅水，翅全湿了。
lines.en: Dropped into a flower-field pool, wings soaked.

lines.zh: 水漫过翅，我飞不起来了。
lines.en: Water over my wings — I can't fly.
The blast tore flowers and leaves away!

lines.zh: 是箭！林子里也有人放箭。
lines.en: An arrow! Archers in the woods too.
The spell runs along my wing veins.
The whole school swam off.

lines.zh: 雷劈在树顶，我的翅发麻。
lines.en: Lightning hit the treetop; my wings tingle.
Below… not even a leaf.
